brief: How to set boundaries without losing the people you love.

slots.title: HOW TO SET BOUNDARIES WITHOUT LOSING LOVE
BOUNDARIES ARE NOT WALLS
slots.body: A boundary is not a barrier. It is the fence that keeps the relationship safe and healthy. Without it, resentment grows instead of love.

slots.title: CLARITY SAVES RELATIONSHIPS
slots.body: Ambiguity breeds anxiety. State what you need plainly and early so the people who love you know how to show up for you.

slots.title: GUILT IS NOT DANGER
slots.body: Feeling guilty does not mean you are wrong. It means you are breaking an old pattern of overgiving that was never sustainable.

slots.title: CONSISTENCY BUILDS REAL TRUST
slots.body: People test boundaries to see if you mean them. Hold your line with kindness every time and the dynamic will shift naturally.

slots.title: YOU CANNOT CONTROL REACTIONS
slots.body: The right people will adjust. The wrong ones will reveal themselves. Either way, you finally get to stop abandoning yourself to keep the peace.

slots.title: BOUNDARIES DEEPEN TRUE CONNECTION
slots.body: When you stop performing and start protecting your peace, you create space for honest love. The people who stay are the ones worth keeping.
